text_en: So the Lord carried out the threat he spoke against us: against our judges who ruled Israel, and against our kings and our rulers and the people of Israel and Judah.
text_cn: 为此，上主实践了他对我们，和对治理以色列的我们的长官，对我们的君王和政要，对以色列人和犹大人所说的话：

text_en: Under the whole heaven there has not been done the like of what he has done in Jerusalem, in accordance with the threats that were written in the law of Moses.
text_cn: 他在耶路撒冷按着梅瑟法律的记载所作的，在普天之下从来没有发生过，

text_en: Some of us ate the flesh of their sons and others the flesh of their daughters.
text_cn: 就是：我们中有人烹食自己儿子的肉，有人烹食自己女儿的肉；

text_en: He made them subject to all the kingdoms around us, to be an object of scorn and a desolation among all the surrounding peoples, where the Lord has scattered them.
text_cn: 且将他们交付给我们四周列国权下，使他们在上主叫他们流徙所到的四邻民族中，遭受诅咒凌辱，

text_en: They were brought down and not raised up, because our nation sinned against the Lord our God, in not heeding his voice.
text_cn: 他们成了阶下囚，不是在人之上，因为我们得罪了上主我们的天主，没有听从他的声音。

text_en: The Lord our God is in the right, but there is open shame on us and our ancestors this very day.
text_cn: 正义属于上主我们的天主，但是，像今日的耻辱，是我们和我们的祖先所应得的。

text_en: All those calamities with which the Lord threatened us have come upon us.
text_cn: 上主对我们所警告的一切灾祸，都来到了我们身上。

text_en: Yet we have not entreated the favor of the Lord by turning away, each of us, from the thoughts of our wicked hearts.
text_cn: 但我们没有勉力求上主息怒，谁也没有离弃自己的邪心恶念，

text_en: And the Lord has kept the calamities ready, and the Lord has brought them upon us, for the Lord is just in all the works that he has commanded us to do.
text_cn: 因此上主常警醒，等待时机，把灾祸降到我们身上；的确，不论上主吩咐我们什么，他常是正义的，

text_en: Yet we have not obeyed his voice, to walk in the statutes of the Lord that he set before us.
text_cn: 只是我们没有听从他的声音，没有按照上主给我们颁赐的法令行事。

text_en: And now, O Lord God of Israel, who brought your people out of the land of Egypt with a mighty hand and with signs and wonders and with great power and outstretched arm, and made yourself a name that continues to this day,
text_cn: 如今，上主，以色列的天主！你曾以强力的手、奇事、神迹、伟大的能力和伸展的手臂，领你的人民出离了埃及地，使你获得有如今日的盛名。

text_en: we have sinned, we have been ungodly, we have done wrong, O Lord our God, against all your ordinances.
text_cn: 上主，我们的天主啊！我们犯了罪，行了不义，违犯了你的一切诫命，

text_en: Let your anger turn away from us, for we are left, few in number, among the nations where you have scattered us.
text_cn: 愿你的义怒不再向我们发作，因为在你使我们流徙所到的民族中，我们剩下的人数已很稀少。

text_en: Hear, O Lord, our prayer and our supplication, and for your own sake deliver us, and grant us favor in the sight of those who have carried us into exile;
text_cn: 上主，求你俯听我们的祈求和哀祷，求你为了你的缘故，拯救我们，恩赐我们在俘掳我们的人前获得宠遇，

text_en: so that all the earth may know that you are the Lord our God, for Israel and his descendants are called by your name.
text_cn: 叫全地都知道你是上主，我们的天主，因为以色列和他的后裔，是归你名下的。

text_en: O Lord, look down from your holy dwelling, and consider us. Incline your ear, O Lord, and hear;
text_cn: 上主，求你从你的圣殿垂视眷念我们；上主，求你侧耳俯听；

text_en: open your eyes, O Lord, and see, for the dead who are in Hades, whose spirit has been taken from their bodies, will not ascribe glory or justice to the Lord;
text_cn: 上主，求你睁眼看一看，不是那些在阴府里，五内已没有气息的死人，能归光荣和正义于上主，

text_en: but the person who is deeply grieved, who walks bowed and feeble, with failing eyes and famished soul, will declare your glory and righteousness, O Lord.
text_cn: 而是备受痛苦的心灵，行走伛偻和力量衰弱，眼睛憔悴无光，和忍饥受饿的生灵，才能归光荣和正义于你，上主！

text_en: For it is not because of any righteous deeds of our ancestors or our kings that we bring before you our prayer for mercy, O Lord our God.
text_cn: 上主，我们的天主！我们并不是仗恃我们祖先或我们君王的功绩，将我们的请求呈递到你台前，

text_en: For you have sent your anger and your wrath upon us, as you declared by your servants the prophets, saying:
text_cn: 因为你曾向我们生气发怒，正如你藉你的仆人先知们申明说：

text_en: Thus says the Lord: Bend your shoulders and serve the king of Babylon, and you will remain in the land that I gave to your ancestors.
text_cn: “上主这样说：你们该低头服事巴比伦王，这样你们便可住在我赐给你们祖先的地上；

text_en: But if you will not obey the voice of the Lord and will not serve the king of Babylon,
text_cn: 假使你们不听从上主的声音，不服事巴比伦王，

text_en: I will make to cease from the towns of Judah and from the region around Jerusalem the voice of mirth and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride, and the whole land will be a desolation without inhabitants.
text_cn: 我就要使犹大城内，和耶路撒冷街上再也听不到欢愉和喜乐的声音，新郎和新娘的声音，全地要变为无人居住的荒野。”

text_en: But we did not obey your voice, to serve the king of Babylon; and you have carried out your threats, which you spoke by your servants the prophets, that the bones of our kings and the bones of our ancestors would be brought out of their resting place;
text_cn: 我们既没有听从你的声音，没有服事巴比伦王，所以你实践了你藉你的仆人先知们说的话：“我们的君王和我们祖先的骨骸，必被人从坟墓中掘出来。”

text_en: and indeed they have been thrown out to the heat of day and the frost of night. They perished in great misery, by famine and sword and pestilence.
text_cn: 看，他们已被掘了出来，日晒夜冻。他们都在极惨的痛苦中，死于饥饿、刀剑和瘟疫；

text_en: And the house that is called by your name you have made as it is today, because of the wickedness of the house of Israel and the house of Judah.
text_cn: 连那归你名下的殿宇，因了以色列家和犹大家的罪孽，你也将它弄成像今日的样子。

text_en: Yet you have dealt with us, O Lord our God, in all your kindness and in all your great compassion,
text_cn: 虽然如此，上主，我们的天主！你对待我们实在宽宏大量，无限仁慈，

text_en: as you spoke by your servant Moses on the day when you commanded him to write your law in the presence of the people of Israel, saying,
text_cn: 正如你在命令你的仆人梅瑟给以色列子民写下你的法律的那天，藉他申明说：

text_en: “If you will not obey my voice, this very great multitude will surely turn into a small number among the nations, where I will scatter them.
text_cn: “假使你们不听从我的声音，这庞大的民众，在我使他们流徙所到的民族中，必会变成弱小的。

text_en: For I know that they will not obey me, for they are a stiff-necked people. But in the land of their exile they will come to themselves
text_cn: 我原知道他们不会听从我，因为他们是一强项的民族；但是在充军的地方，他们必回心转意，

text_en: and know that I am the Lord their God. I will give them a heart that obeys and ears that hear;
text_cn: 承认我是上主，他们的天主，我也要赐他们心明耳顺，

text_en: they will praise me in the land of their exile, and will remember my name
text_cn: 叫他们在充军之地赞美我，记念我的名号。

text_en: and turn from their stubbornness and their wicked deeds; for they will remember the ways of their ancestors, who sinned before the Lord.
text_cn: 他们必回心转意，不再强项，不再作恶，因为他们记着他们在上主面前犯罪的祖先的结局。

text_en: I will bring them again into the land that I swore to give to their ancestors, to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and they will rule over it; and I will increase them, and they will not be diminished.
text_cn: 那时，我要再领他们回到我起誓许给他们的祖先亚巴郎、依撒格和雅各伯的地域去，叫他们恢复祖业；我也要增加他们的人数，叫他们不再减少；

text_en: I will make an everlasting covenant with them to be their God and they shall be my people; and I will never again remove my people Israel from the land that I have given them. ”
text_cn: 我要与他们订立永久的盟约：我要作他们的天主，他们要作我的人民；我决不再将我的人民以色列逐出我赐与他们的地域。”
